storage: Airtight container at room temperature, away from moisture: 6–12 months. Soaked sabudana: use the same day; it can be kept covered in the fridge overnight, but it may stick together.
looksLike: Small, hard, opaque white balls, 2–3 mm across for the medium size. After soaking they swell, soften and turn slightly translucent at the edges.
shelfLife: About 9–12 months in a sealed pack; keep dry once opened.

usedIn.raw: 75 g raw (about ½ cup), soaked before cooking
